comment: The commercial feature set (payment, order, coupon, invite commission) that lives in the private anix-control-commercial repository. Files in commercial and wiring may reference it freely. Every other non-test Go file may reference a commercial symbol only if it is listed in allowed_dependents; the list is a ratchet: it is empty now and must stay empty unless the owner approves. check_commercial_boundary.py enforces it (docs/architecture/commercial-boundary.md). Invite codes (registration gating) stay in the community edition; only commission, withdrawal and affiliate are commercial.
